summary: RETRYLEFT1 (operator-approved 10-07 after NCPL: cancel the sibling waiting buy on both brokers once the segment's trade has closed and no second buy is allowed). schwab_1m_v2: when the exact owned trade closes in its causal SELL cycle and retry_one_closes_in_segment >= 1+MAX_RETRIES (installed RETRY_ONE_ENABLED=true, MAX_RETRIES=0), _cancel_retry_leftovers emits the existing serial buy-only cancellation barrier on both configured accounts (purpose=retry_exhausted, reason retry_budget_exhausted) via the CLEARWAIT1 RemovedWait store, drops queued open intents, ends the pre-market software rest (cw_armed/atr_hold_pending/first-rest wait) and clears resting flags; skipped when every account already filled (APUS shape), when positions are open, or when a request/receipt already exists. The symbol stays gated until the receipt proves every account's cancel settled (cancelled, or refused as cancel_target_not_found); unknown/refused answers stay blocking; the receipt never retires the owner (no second entry). Store schema: purpose field, restored requests re-emit their barriers after restart, unknown purpose refused. OMS target selection (store.py) is by strategy/account/symbol/side/segment/open-status, so the cancel quantity is irrelevant. Verified by claude-1: 41 focused passed; my mutations in a separate worktree: receipt-retires-owner 2F, unknown-cancel-accepted 3F, budget off-by-one 32F; both-filled guard removed SURVIVED (the only test of that shape also has open positions — the guard is belt-and-braces: with every account filled and flat there is no waiting buy, a cancel would answer cancel_target_not_found and be accepted); full unit suite failed-name set identical to base 994f08ae. Live flags checked on the box: RETRY_ONE_ENABLED=true, MAX_RETRIES=0, REMOVED_WAIT_CLEAR_ENABLED=true, DUAL_BROKER_FANOUT=true, Webull account live:orb — so the widened gate/poll conditions change nothing in production. Hot path: one dict lookup per gate call, no new per-tick DB work; proofs read in the existing periodic to_thread poll. Not verified: real broker cancel latency (simulated in tests); first live leftover cancel to be read tomorrow.
